prompt: Please capture a realistic screenshot from a fictional next-generation 3D open-world romance RPG, presented from the male protagonist’s first-person perspective.  On the beach, Morrigan Aensland from Darkstalkers invites the protagonist to help her apply sunscreen.  The overall visual style must feature high-quality cartoon-rendered 3D characters combined with Unreal Engine 5-level graphics, achieving AAA-quality visual fidelity. It should include ultra-detailed character modeling, realistic skin shading, cinematic lighting, PBR materials, high-precision clothing textures, and finely rendered classroom environments. The final image must look like an actual playable game screenshot, including a complete game user interface: minimap, quest display, character status bars, interaction prompts, dialogue subtitles, HUD elements, and more.

promptZh: 请捕捉一张来自虚构的次世代 3D 开放世界 恋爱 RPG 的逼真游戏截图，以男主角的第一人称视角呈现。在 海滩 上，《恶魔战士》中的莫莉卡·安斯兰 邀请主角帮她涂抹防晒霜。整体视觉风格必须采用高质量的卡通渲染 3D 角色，并结合虚幻引擎 5 级别的图形效果，达到 AAA 级的视觉保真度。画面应包含超精细的角色建模、逼真的皮肤着色、电影级光影、PBR 材质、高精度服装纹理以及细腻的教室环境渲染。最终图像必须看起来像一张真实的可玩游戏截图，并包含完整的游戏用户界面：小地图、任务显示、角色状态栏、交互提示、对话字幕、HUD 元素等。
